lede: The San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Wednesday is the one to watch — they'll consider Resolution 2026-34, which would change Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park, a technical move that directly shapes who actually qualifies for affordable housing here. Also Wednesday, the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments touching forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy. Over in Ridgway Tuesday, the Town Council meets on a heavy agenda that includes ratifying support for a federal Major Disaster Declaration tied to the nearly 40,000-acre Gold Mountain Fire.

notable.stake: AMI threshold change on deed-restricted units determines who qualifies for local housing.
Planning Commission votes on three Land Use Code amendments: forestry, oil/gas, geothermal.
Council ratifies disaster declaration support for the 40,000-acre Gold Mountain Fire.
